validation_plan: Parse SKILL.md frontmatter (name / description / kind / artifact-contract).
Parse schemas/artifact_contract.json and confirm all 3 slots declare promotable + user_visible.
Parse 3 *.schema.json files and 3 *.minimum.json files; validate minimum instances with AJV.
Run protocol_compliance: all 3 schemas pass the wrapper 6-field / slot const / layout_type=single / component_type=markdown / detail.type=null protocol checks.
Run layout_plan_cross_check: artifact_layout_plan in _design/skill_structure.json matches schema consts.
Run unsupported_command_audit: SKILL.md / PHASE.md do not contain future commands such as dl skill draft-create / draft-update / validate / compile / activate / fork / search.
Run artifact_contract_usage: write / finalize / validate calls include --contract; patch-json uses supported JSONPath-lite ops and omits --contract.
Confirm all 3 phases/*.md files are present (01-concept / 02-outline / 03-script).
runtime_boundaries: Approval density / checkpoint trigger mechanisms / pause-resume strategy are runtime-owned. The skill only describes the methodological rule: run the agent self-check (against the skill's criteria + persona + creative brief) after verify before promoting.
Skill reload / registration / publishing are runtime-owned. After source files are written, the Pi runtime picks them up.
Budgets and quotas (such as maximum calls per phase) are runtime-owned and not written into the skill.
Downstream rendering / compositing / TTS / music are outside this skill; the skill ends once the script is persisted.

artifact_layout_plan.notes: One coherent narrative: Path / basic dimensions / Concept section (What-If) or Form section (How-to-Tell).
One coherent narrative: structure type / audiovisual techniques / paragraph outline (with runtime + dual-track pacing) / logical validity of the twist.
Full screenplay + runtime estimate + twist-strength self-review + alternatives. Terminal artifact; after promotion, skill is complete.
